literal: Laziness in noble birth if it stays, to one's own foes slavery having caused to enter it will leave.
translation: If laziness takes root in a person of noble birth, it will force them into slavery under their own enemies.
modern: ஒரு நல்ல குடியில் பிறந்தவனிடம் சோம்பல் தங்கிவிட்டால், அது அவனை அவனுடைய பகைவர்களுக்கு அடிமையாக்கி விடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns of the severe consequences of laziness for someone born into a good family. The word 'குடிமை' refers to noble birth or family honor, which requires active effort to maintain. If sluggishness ('மடிமை') is allowed to stay ('தங்கின்'), it strips away this independence and strength. Ultimately, it reduces the person to a state of servitude ('அடிமை') to their very enemies, contrasting the dignity of a noble lineage with the humiliation of slavery.
